goal: Save/load and share-seed round trip: save from the pause menu, stop, `pt start --continue`, confirm the world is identical; then start a new world from the seed shown on the Share screen and confirm it matches. This build changed the save format (v6) to store diplomacy envoys. Before saving, lead a nation and make at least one diplomacy act on the Nations screen (O) so an envoy is on the road; save while it is away, quit, `pt start --continue`, and confirm the envoy is still away with the same remaining time (Nations screen row 'envoy back in N s') and the rest of the world matches.

findings.title: Nations screen: diplomacy buttons for a nation whose envoy is away are not dimmed
findings.detail: After paying tribute, the row reads 'envoy back in 20 s' but Tribute/Ally/War/Denounce look exactly like the buttons of a nation you can deal with. Clicking one correctly refuses ('Your envoy to Westernham is still on the road: you can deal with them again in 20 seconds of play.') and charges nothing (coins stay 231), so this is only a visual hint gap. Expected the row's buttons greyed out while the envoy travels.
findings.repro: pt start --seed Ironvale; Start, Begin; pt key n; wait until another nation is founded (~tick 950); pt key o; pt click 123 255 (Tribute); pt click 123 255 again

findings.title: New World seed box keeps the previous seed and Ctrl+A does not select it
findings.detail: Going Main Menu > Start after playing, the seed box still holds 'Ironvale'. Clicking it and pressing Ctrl+A then BackSpace removed only the last character ('Ironval'), so typing the shared seed produced 'Ironval1450162717' (a different world, though the label under the box shows the resolved seed so it is noticeable). Had to press BackSpace 20 times. Expected Ctrl+A to select all, or a clear button, since pasting a shared seed is the main use of this box. (Low frame rate may contribute; tried once.)
findings.repro: From a world: Escape > Main Menu > Start; pt click 480 235; pt key ctrl+a BackSpace; pt type 1450162717

verdict: The v6 save round trip works: with a tribute envoy away (row read 'envoy back in 15 s' at tick 1440), Save, then pt stop and --continue, resumed at tick 1448 with position, heading, coins, inventory, nation, role, objective, settlement and nearby trees/rocks/chickens all identical, and the envoy row read 'envoy back in 12 s' after 112 more ticks (2.2 s), which is exactly the time that had passed. The Share screen shows seed 1450162717 plus a link, and a new world from that number matched the original start exactly (same HUD, region, distances and bearings, the same pawn names, and Isabella Wood again founding the first AI nation and settlement). Save feedback is very good ('Saved: Day 1 - Upperford, 18:03', 'Welcome back'). Two small UI nits only: envoy-away buttons aren't dimmed, and the seed box is awkward to clear.
